description: The adult height a child is expected to reach, estimated from both parents' heights with Tanner's mid-parental method: (mother + father +13 cm for a boy, -13 cm for a girl) / 2, with a range of 8.5 cm either side. Use it for 'how tall will my child be', 'mid-parental height' and 'child height predictor' questions. It is a statistical range, not a forecast for one child, and says nothing about the child's height today. Optionally, with the child's age (24-240 months) and current height, it adds a CDC projection: today's z-score on the CDC 2000 stature-for-age chart carried to age 20, with a range of one standard deviation either side; a height more than 5 SD from the CDC median for the age is refused as an entry error. Centimetres only: convert feet and inches first (5 ft 10 in = 177.8 cm).

childAgeMonths.description: Optional, with childHeightCm: the child's age in months (2 to 20 years), for the CDC projection.

childHeightCm.description: Optional, with childAgeMonths: the child's current height in centimetres, measured standing.

locale.description: Language for the disclaimer and any clinician note. Pass the language you will answer the user in: these are clinical safety texts written by a physician, and they should reach the reader as written rather than translated by the model.

sex.description: The child's sex: the formula adds or subtracts 13 cm accordingly.
